evidence.detail: base GROUP_CONCAT query uses ELSE '' — when position=1 face has NULL loyalty (non-planeswalkers in multi-face layouts), GROUP_CONCAT collects '' from position≥2 faces and returns '' instead of NULL
math_where checks column IS NOT NULL, which passes for '' (empty string), then '' < 3 evaluates to TRUE in MariaDB, causing false positives for adventure/flip/meld/modal_dfc/split/transform cards
bakert's comments confirm the root cause is the ELSE '' in the GROUP_CONCAT query at card.py base query

triage.fix_sketch: In magic/card.py:99, change `ELSE '' END` to `ELSE NULL END` in the base GROUP_CONCAT query. Since GROUP_CONCAT ignores NULLs, this makes cards where position=1 has a NULL value (loyalty, power, toughness) return NULL rather than '' — matching the IS NOT NULL check in math_where. No other fields are affected because name, mana_cost, cmc, type_line, oracle_text, hand, life each have their own overriding queries.
triage.notes: The fix also corrects the same bug for power and toughness on non-creature multi-face cards. No code outside the query checks loyalty == '' (confirmed by grep).
